request.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT

layers.text: Turn it into an ice-age hide boat: the pale hull becomes dark brown-grey hide over wood, colour #493736 with #2d2b2b shadows; the red tarp becomes heaped blankets of shaggy warm white fur, colour #e3d5b7 shaded warm taupe #8c7667, never blue-grey; the pennant becomes a clear bright ice-blue crystal on top of the pole. Keep the oars, boat shape, size, thick black outline and style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
